title: Do Male Seahorses Give Birth? 🐠 #Shorts
description:
Yes — male seahorses give birth! The male seahorse is the only animal on Earth where the dad gets pregnant, carrying up to 2,000 babies in his brood pouch.
After the female deposits her eggs into his pouch, he fertilizes them and nourishes the growing seahorse babies with oxygen and nutrients through placenta-like tissue for 10 days to 6 weeks.
